environment: Mercy PR #229 code and Happy Food Rescue Railway staging
acceptedScope: Harden PR #229 by separating merchant and Mercy integration credentials, proving negative cross-surface authorization before mutation, and documenting when the staging harness may count as E2E evidence.
authorizationSource: Owner request in this chat on 2026-10-06.
decisions: Continue the existing current-main-based PR #229 branch rather than create a dependent PR.
Pin the live harness to https://happy-food-staging-staging.up.railway.app and expected Happy staging revision 0917bb8f7b43805f02242db8b70d1733da6c25f5.
Treat HAPPY_FOOD_RESCUE_API_TOKEN and HAPPY_FOOD_RESCUE_TOKEN as distinct least-privilege staging credentials and fail before mutation if they are equal.

Exercise integration-token-on-merchant using read-only GET_CAPABILITIES and merchant-token-on-integration using an invalid envelope so negative boundary checks cannot mutate state even when authorization is broken.
A skipped/default CI run, Vercel Preview, test-file presence, or declared revision variable is not cross-system E2E evidence.
Accept E2E only when the same Mercy head non-skipped run is paired with independent successful Happy staging deployment evidence for the exact pinned SHA and origin.

scenarios.acceptance: Before mutation, tokens are distinct; integration credential is 401 on merchant surface and merchant credential is 401 on integration surface.
Create donation lot, reserve through Mercy, replay idempotently, attest partial delivery, and verify final version, availability, donated quantity, custody quantity and completed reservation.
Any E2E claim binds exact Mercy head, pinned Happy origin/revision, independent successful Happy deploy evidence and a non-skipped live run; skipped/default CI remains explicitly unverified.

completion: Report implementation, PR/merge state, live staging execution and accepted E2E evidence as separate facts.
